entry.title: SilverBullet 2
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 600.00

Pick & decode more than 99% of disc-based locks

The SilverBullet 2 is a highly efficient,  easily customisable precision tool engineered for rapid opening and accurate decoding of disc-retainer locks and padlocks.

Designed as a one-tool-fits-all or "Silver Bullet" against disc-based locks, it can open over 99% of current makes and models, including: 

  • Abloy Disclock
  • Abloy Classic
  • Abloy Profile (All Profiles)
  • Anchor Las
  • Abus Granit (all versions)
  • Abus Plus, Plus RK, X-Plus
  • IFAM
  • Master Lock (all versions)
  • Kryptonite (all versions)
  • All Chinese generic locks

Over 99% coverage

One tool for Abloy, Abus Granit, Master Lock, Kryptonite and Anchor Las: over 99% of disc-based locks on the market.

Pick and decode

18° engraved markings on the body read the combination straight off the lock, so the next open is faster than the first.

Modular build

Five picking tips and seven tension tips hot-swap for any profile. Front tension, rear tension, or run the whole tool in reverse.

Built to outlast the locks

Individually machined from 17-4 PH aerospace-grade stainless steel and backed by a lifetime guarantee.

UNDERSTAND THE SILVERBULLET 2

Six parts do the work: the tips that touch the discs, the body that reads them, and the tension system that ties it together. Here is what you are holding.

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4
  • 5
  • 6

1. Precision-machined body

Individually machined from 17-4 PH precipitation-hardened stainless steel for fine control and repeatable precision.

2. Depth graduations

The internal body is double-graduated at 1.6mm and 2mm: a depth indicator and disc locator for the majority of locks.

3. 18° decode markings

Incremental 18° engravings on the external body let you read and record the lock's combination as you pick.

4. Modular tension system

Seven tension tips apply pressure at the front or rear: Universal, ABUS, Long, Mini and two Abloy options.

5. Modular tip mount

Tips and tension tools thread onto the body, so one tool reconfigures for almost any disc-detainer lock.

6. Interchangeable picking tips

Front, Rear, Mini, Abloy and Abloy Classic feeler tips swap in seconds to match the lock's profile.

    • 1x Universal (Rear Tip)

entry.title: Cutaway Practice Cylinder
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 60.00

Reliable picking skills start here

Picking precisely and rapidly requires building strong fundamentals through practice. The right choice of practice lock is crucial to ensure to steady progress, avoid frustration and develop skills that are relevant to the locks you'll encounter in the field.

The 6-Pin Euro Cylinder "Advanced" Training Kit is the perfect springboard for building and refining your picking skills.

6-Pin cylinders are common in Europe - once you've mastered 6-pins, any lock with less pins is dramatically easier.

This cylinder is re-keyable and cut-away, which allows you to change pin depths and pin types as you progress.

With a full kit of standard and high-security pins (serrated, spool, etc) - this one kit meets your current and future requirements.

This cylinder can be used for learning and perfecting raking, single pin picking, impressioning and electric pickgun skills.

What's included

  • 1x Euro 6-Pin Tumbler Lock
  • 1x Set Replacement Pins (40pcs, Standard + High security)
  • 1x Set Replacement Springs
  • 1x Set Replacement Grub Screws
  • 1x Tweezers
  • 1x Allen Key for re-pinning
  • 1x Original Key
  • 1x Door mounting screw
  • 1x Storage Case

Technical Information

  • Dimensions: 60x10x30mm Cylinder

entry.title: Kronos Electric Pick
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 215.00

The Kronos Electric Pick is the most effective tool to pick regular pin tumbler locks without struggling. The preferred non-destructive entry-tool of locksmiths, it requires virtually no learning, and can open more than 75% of locks with some practice.

Choosing an electric pick gun can be complicated: there are many models available; Kronos earned its place in Lab401's toolkit for the following reasons:

  • Reliable and quiet: a tool you can trust.
  • Two-hours continuous battery life in each charge. You'll run out of locks before it runs out of battery.
  • Powerful actuator for defeating high-tensile or mixed-tensile springs in high-security and specialised locks.
  • Configurable: Tweak the amplitude peak (range) of the tool to meet your style or the lock's requirements.
  • German build-quality: High-grade aluminum, pocket-sized and German-made quality.

What's included:

Each Kronos Electric Pick Gun set contains:

  • 1x Kronos Electric Pick Gun
  • 1x Li-Ion battery
  • 1x Battery Charger

Each kit comes with the following accessories:

  • 5x Replacement Pick needs (0.5mm)
  • 2x Tension Wrenches
  • 1x Allen Key for pick replacement

Technical Information

  • Adjustable Range: 1 - 4mm at needle chuck
  • Idle Speed: 13,000 RPM
  • Battery: 3.7V / 2900mAH

  • Weight: 350g (with battery)
  • Dimensions: 20cm x 3.5cm

entry.summary:

Results-oriented lockpick pack

Successful lockpicking requires the right tools. There are literally hundreds of kits on the market, but it's hard to know what you need now, what you'll need later, and which tools are useful and which tools are redundant.

The Lab401 Lockpicking Pack includes the picks and tension wrenches you can't live without, and no fluff. With this pack, you have everything you need to learn, perfection and apply your lockpicking skills in the field during audits.

The pack is built on 10+ years of in-the-field experience and refining our own picking "every-day carry" kits.

  • 1
  • 2
  • 3
  • 4
  • 5

1. 0,5mm "Elite Hook"

Designed for setting pins in deep positions in tight keyways, such as EU cylinders or smaller padlocks.

2. 0,7mm "Elite Hook"

Your "everyday" hook pick for setting deep positions.

3. 0,5mm "Half Diamond"

Your daily-driver tool for individual picking. Thin, flexible, strong.

4. 0,5mm "Snake"

The perfect balance between raking and picking, increasing setting chances across adjacent pins.

5. 0,5mm "City Rake"

The City Rake maximising your chances of success when you don't have enough time to pick individual pins.

1. 2,4mm "Twist" Tension Wrench

Thinnest "twist" wrench for tight keyways. Long length for precise tension control.

2. 2,6mm "Twist" Tension Wrench

Standard "twist" wrench. Useful for precise control, or when blocked by door frames.

3. 3,2mm "Twist" Tension Wrench

Widest "twist" wrench for tight control on larger keyways.

4. 2,4mm Z-Bend Tension Wrench

Thinnest double-ended wrench for tight keyways. Features short + long end.

4. 2,6mm Z-Bend Tension Wrench

Double-ended wrench in a short + long configuration.

6. 3,2mm Z-Bend Tension Wrench

Widest double-ended wrench for tight control on larger keyways. Features short + long end.
